66	// Update implements tea.Model
67	func (m *Model) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
68		switch msg := msg.(type) {
69		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
70			m.width = msg.Width
71			m.height = msg.Height
72			m.resizeInputs()
73			m.filterBar.Resize(msg.Width)
74			m.rebuildChecksTable()
75			m.resizeDetailsViewport()
76			m.portsModel.resize(msg.Width, msg.Height)
77			m.interfacesModel.resize(msg.Width, msg.Height)
78			m.forwardModel.resize(msg.Width, msg.Height)
79			m.pathModel.resize(msg.Width, msg.Height)
80			return m, nil
81	
82		// The router's animation frame: the blink phase of the Ports dot and of the
83		// two footers that show the shared activity dot, whichever tab is on screen
84		// so a tab never comes back with a frozen phase.
85		case jobs.FrameMsg:
86			m.portsModel.table.SetBlinkPhase(msg.Blink)
87			m.footer.SetBlinkPhase(msg.Blink)
88			m.interfacesModel.footer.SetBlinkPhase(msg.Blink)
89			m.pathModel.footer.SetBlinkPhase(msg.Blink)
90			return m, nil
91	
92		case stageDoneMsg:
93			return m.handleStageDone(msg)
94	
95		// Ports sub-model messages.
96		case portsTickMsg, portsDataMsg, portsKillResultMsg:
97			var cmd tea.Cmd
98			m.portsModel, cmd = m.portsModel.update(msg)
99			return m, cmd
100	
101		// The terminal focus reaches the ports poll on every tab: its tick runs
102		// whichever tab shows.
103		case shared.TerminalFocusMsg:
104			var cmd tea.Cmd
105			m.portsModel, cmd = m.portsModel.update(msg)
106			return m, cmd
107	
108		// Two tabs now ask before they act — Ports before a kill (§3.26), Forward
109		// before dropping the connections a redirection is carrying — so the answer
110		// goes to the tab that asked rather than to Ports unconditionally, which
111		// would have confirmed a kill from the Forward tab's modal.
112		case components.ConfirmModalYesMsg, components.ConfirmModalNoMsg:
113			return m.routeConfirm(msg)
114	
115		// Forward sub-model messages. ChangedMsg is the router's broadcast, and it
116		// reaches this view wherever it stands, on screen or not.
117		case forward.ChangedMsg, forwardTickMsg, ForwardFormSubmitMsg, ForwardFormCancelMsg:
118			var cmd tea.Cmd
119			m.forwardModel, cmd = m.forwardModel.update(msg)
120			return m, cmd
121	
122		// Path sub-model messages: a trace goes on, and its hops keep arriving,
123		// whichever tab is on screen.
124		case pathResolvedMsg, pathHopMsg, pathDoneMsg, pathSourcesMsg:
125			var cmd tea.Cmd
126			m.pathModel, cmd = m.pathModel.update(msg)
127			return m, cmd
128	
129		// Topology sub-model messages
130		case ifaceDataMsg:
131			var cmd tea.Cmd
132			m.interfacesModel, cmd = m.interfacesModel.update(msg)
133			return m, cmd
134	
135		case tea.KeyPressMsg:
136			return m.handleKey(msg)
137	
138		case tea.PasteMsg:
139			return m.handlePaste(msg)
140		}
141	
142		// Each tab holds its own footer, so an expiry has to be offered to all
143		// five: the timer fires wherever the user has since navigated. The Path tab
144		// also takes the cursor blink of its field.
145		m.footer.Handle(msg)
146		m.portsModel.footer.Handle(msg)
147		m.interfacesModel.footer.Handle(msg)
148		m.forwardModel.footer.Handle(msg)
149		var cmd tea.Cmd
150		m.pathModel, cmd = m.pathModel.update(msg)
151		return m, cmd
152	}
153	
154	// routeConfirm hands a confirmation answer to the tab that put the modal up.
155	func (m *Model) routeConfirm(msg tea.Msg) (*Model, tea.Cmd) {
156		var cmd tea.Cmd
157		if m.activeTab == tabForward {
158			m.forwardModel, cmd = m.forwardModel.update(msg)
159			return m, cmd
160		}
161		m.portsModel, cmd = m.portsModel.update(msg)
162		return m, cmd
163	}

165	// handleStageDone records one stage's answers and starts the next.
166	func (m *Model) handleStageDone(msg stageDoneMsg) (*Model, tea.Cmd) {
167		if msg.gen != m.runGen {
168			return m, nil // a superseded run
169		}
170		m.results = msg.results
171		m.rebuildChecksTable()
172	
173		steps := netcheck.Steps()
174		if msg.next >= len(steps) {
175			m.state = StateResults
176			m.verdict = netcheck.Summarize(m.results.All())
177			log.Printf("INFO [netdiag] run finished: verdict=%s over %d checks",
178				m.verdict, len(m.results.All()))
179			return m, nil
180		}
181	
182		m.runStep = msg.next
183		m.runStage = steps[msg.next]
184	
185		tg, err := m.buildTarget()
186		if err != nil {
187			// The form has not changed since the run started, so this cannot
188			// normally fail. Reporting it beats continuing with a target nobody
189			// can name.
190			log.Printf("ERROR [netdiag] target became invalid mid-run: %v", err)
191			m.state = StateResults
192			return m, m.footer.Error("Run stopped — the target is no longer valid")
193		}
194		return m, runStageCmd(m.runGen, tg, m.checkSettings(), msg.next, m.results)
195	}

197	// handlePaste gives pasted text to the field that has the keyboard on the tab on
198	// screen. It never reaches the key handlers, so no action fires (Rule 111).
199	func (m *Model) handlePaste(msg tea.PasteMsg) (*Model, tea.Cmd) {
200		var cmd tea.Cmd
201		switch m.activeTab {
202		case tabPorts:
203			m.portsModel, cmd = m.portsModel.update(msg)
204		case tabInterfaces:
205			m.interfacesModel, cmd = m.interfacesModel.update(msg)
206		case tabForward:
207			m.forwardModel, cmd = m.forwardModel.update(msg)
208		case tabPath:
209			m.pathModel, cmd = m.pathModel.update(msg)
210		default:
211			switch {
212			case m.filterBar.InEditMode():
213				m.filterBar, cmd = m.filterBar.Update(msg)
214				m.rebuildChecksTable()
215			case m.state == StateInput:
216				return m.updateActiveInput(msg)
217			}
218		}
219		return m, cmd
220	}

222	func (m *Model) handleKey(msg tea.KeyPressMsg) (*Model, tea.Cmd) {
223		// A filter bar in edit mode claims every key before anything else, or a
224		// query cannot contain the letters the view binds.
225		if m.activeTab == tabDiagnostics && m.filterBar.InEditMode() {
226			var cmd tea.Cmd
227			m.filterBar, cmd = m.filterBar.Update(msg)
228			m.rebuildChecksTable()
229			return m, cmd
230		}
231	
232		// An open selector holds every key, tab included: it is a mode.
233		if m.activeTab == tabPath && m.pathModel.pickerOpen() {
234			var cmd tea.Cmd
235			m.pathModel, cmd = m.pathModel.update(msg)
236			return m, cmd
237		}
238	
239		// Tab / Shift+Tab cycles between the tabs (Rule 135)
240		switch msg.String() {
241		case "tab":
242			m.activeTab = (m.activeTab + 1) % tabCount
243			return m, nil
244		case "shift+tab":
245			m.activeTab = (m.activeTab + tabCount - 1) % tabCount
246			return m, nil
247		}
248	
249		// Route to active tab
250		if m.activeTab == tabPorts {
251			var cmd tea.Cmd
252			m.portsModel, cmd = m.portsModel.update(msg)
253			return m, cmd
254		}
255		if m.activeTab == tabInterfaces {
256			var cmd tea.Cmd
257			m.interfacesModel, cmd = m.interfacesModel.update(msg)
258			return m, cmd
259		}
260		if m.activeTab == tabForward {
261			var cmd tea.Cmd
262			m.forwardModel, cmd = m.forwardModel.update(msg)
263			return m, cmd
264		}
265		if m.activeTab == tabPath {
266			var cmd tea.Cmd
267			m.pathModel, cmd = m.pathModel.update(msg)
268			return m, cmd
269		}
270	
271		switch m.state {
272		case StateInput:
273			return m.handleKeyInput(msg)
274		case StateRunning:
275			return m.handleKeyRunning(msg)
276		case StateResults:
277			return m.handleKeyResults(msg)
278		case StateDetails:
279			return m.handleKeyDetails(msg)
280		}
281		return m, nil
282	}
283	
284	// handleKeyRunning cancels the run. The stage in flight is awaited rather than
285	// interrupted — it is a network read that will time out on its own — and its
286	// result is discarded by the generation counter.
287	func (m *Model) handleKeyRunning(msg tea.KeyPressMsg) (*Model, tea.Cmd) {
288		if msg.String() != "esc" {
289			return m, nil
290		}
291		m.runGen++
292		m.state = StateResults
293		m.verdict = netcheck.Summarize(m.results.All())
294		m.rebuildChecksTable()
295		return m, m.footer.Warn("Run cancelled — showing what completed")
296	}

298	func (m *Model) handleKeyInput(msg tea.KeyPressMsg) (*Model, tea.Cmd) {
299		switch msg.String() {
300		case "down":
301			m.moveFocus(1)
302			return m, nil
303		case "up":
304			m.moveFocus(-1)
305			return m, nil
306		case "enter":
307			// enter runs the checks from anywhere in the form, so the user need
308			// not walk to the button first; only the Trace Path button means
309			// something else.
310			if m.focusedField == fieldTraceButton {
311				return m.traceFromForm()
312			}
313			return m.StartRun()
314		case "esc":
315			return m, nil
316		}
317		return m.updateActiveInput(msg)
318	}

320	func (m *Model) moveFocus(delta int) {
321		switch m.focusedField {
322		case fieldTarget:
323			m.targetInput.Blur()
324		case fieldPort:
325			m.portInput.Blur()
326		case fieldDNSServer:
327			m.dnsServerInput.Blur()
328		}
329	
330		m.focusedField = (m.focusedField + delta + fieldCount) % fieldCount
331	
332		switch m.focusedField {
333		case fieldTarget:
334			m.targetInput.Focus()
335		case fieldPort:
336			m.portInput.Focus()
337		case fieldDNSServer:
338			m.dnsServerInput.Focus()
339		}
340	}

342	func (m *Model) updateActiveInput(msg tea.Msg) (*Model, tea.Cmd) {
343		var cmd tea.Cmd
344		switch m.focusedField {
345		case fieldTarget:
346			m.targetInput, cmd = m.targetInput.Update(msg)
347			m.revalidateTrace()
348		case fieldPort:
349			m.portInput, cmd = m.portInput.Update(msg)
350		case fieldDNSServer:
351			m.dnsServerInput, cmd = m.dnsServerInput.Update(msg)
352		}
353		return m, cmd
354	}
355	
356	func (m *Model) handleKeyResults(msg tea.KeyPressMsg) (*Model, tea.Cmd) {
357		switch msg.String() {
358		case "enter":
359			return m.openDetails()
360		case "esc":
361			// No origin view means netdiag was opened directly (the command
362			// line), so esc stays inside it and resets to the form, as it
363			// always has. An origin means it was opened prefilled from
364			// elsewhere (status's H, §3.66), and esc returns there instead.
365			if m.OriginView == "" {
366				return m.resetToForm()
367			}
368			origin := m.OriginView
369			return m, func() tea.Msg { return BackToOriginMsg{Origin: origin} }
370		case "ctrl+r":
371			return m.StartRun()
372		case "/":
373			return m, m.filterBar.ActivateSearch()
374		case "p":
375			m.filterBar.SetTokenActive(problemsToken, !m.filterBar.IsTokenActive(problemsToken))
376			m.rebuildChecksTable()
377			return m, nil
378		case keymap.Diagnose:
379			return m.tracePathFromRoute()
380		case keymap.New:
381			// Always resets to the form, regardless of OriginView — the one way
382			// to run a wholly new diagnostic without first leaving to wherever
383			// this run was opened from. Found missing the day §3.66 shipped H:
384			// esc alone left no way back to the form once an origin was set, and
385			// re-entering netdiag through the command line landed on the same
386			// frozen results with the same problem, since the cached view (and
387			// its OriginView) is reused rather than rebuilt.
388			return m.resetToForm()
389		}
390		return m, m.checksTable.Update(msg)
391	}

393	func (m *Model) handleKeyDetails(msg tea.KeyPressMsg) (*Model, tea.Cmd) {
394		switch msg.String() {
395		case "esc":
396			m.state = StateResults
397			return m, nil
398		case "up":
399			m.detailsViewport.ScrollUp(1)
400		case "down":
401			m.detailsViewport.ScrollDown(1)
402		case "pgup":
403			m.detailsViewport.HalfPageUp()
404		case "pgdown":
405			m.detailsViewport.HalfPageDown()
406		case "home":
407			m.detailsViewport.GotoTop()
408		case "end":
409			m.detailsViewport.GotoBottom()
410		}
411		return m, nil
412	}
413	
414	func (m *Model) openDetails() (*Model, tea.Cmd) {
415		c, ok := m.checksTable.Selected()
416		if !ok {
417			return m, nil
418		}
419		m.selected = c
420		m.state = StateDetails
421		m.resizeDetailsViewport()
422		m.detailsViewport.SetContent(m.renderDetailsContent(m.detailsViewport.Width()))
423		m.detailsViewport.GotoTop()
424		return m, nil
425	}
426	
427	func (m *Model) resetToForm() (*Model, tea.Cmd) {
428		m.state = StateInput
429		m.focusedField = fieldTarget
430		m.targetInput.Focus()
431		m.results = netcheck.Results{}
432		m.verdict = netcheck.Unknown
433		m.filterBar.ClearSearch()
434		m.filterBar.SetTokenActive(problemsToken, false)
435		m.rebuildChecksTable()
436		// Starting over severs the tie to wherever this run was opened from: the
437		// next run is not "the monitor status sent here" anymore, so esc on its
438		// results should not try to leave for a view this new target has nothing
439		// to do with.
440		m.OriginView = ""
441		return m, nil
442	}

18	// View is the Bubble Tea v2 face of Render: the content only. The terminal

22	// Render implements tea.Model
23	func (m *Model) Render() string {
24		switch m.activeTab {
25		case tabPorts:
26			// The kill confirmation is centred over the tab, like every other
27			// modal (Rule 112).
28			if modal := m.portsModel.confirmModal; modal != nil {
29				return lipgloss.Place(
30					m.width, m.height,
31					lipgloss.Center, lipgloss.Center,
32					modal.View(),
33					lipgloss.WithWhitespaceStyle(lipgloss.NewStyle().Background(theme.ColorBackground)),
34				)

37		case tabInterfaces:
38			return m.interfacesModel.view()
39		case tabPath:
40			return m.pathModel.view()
41		case tabForward:
42			// The stop confirmation is centred over the tab, like every other
43			// modal (Rule 112).
44			if modal := m.forwardModel.confirmModal; modal != nil {
45				return lipgloss.Place(
46					m.width, m.height,
47					lipgloss.Center, lipgloss.Center,
48					modal.View(),
49					lipgloss.WithWhitespaceStyle(lipgloss.NewStyle().Background(theme.ColorBackground)),
50				)
51			}
52			return m.forwardModel.view()
53		}
54		switch m.state {
55		case StateInput:
56			return m.renderInputForm()
57		case StateRunning, StateResults:
58			// The table stays on screen while the pipeline runs, filling in as each
59			// stage lands. A body that swaps itself for a spinner loses its header
60			// and its columns (Rule 139), and here it would also throw away the
61			// rows already answered.
62			return m.renderChecks()

Tests rouges écrits. Rien n'a été exécuté contre le code de prod (il n'existe pas encore) et rien n'est commité.

**Fichiers touchés**
- Créé `internal\ui\netdiag\trace_level_test.go` (environ 25 tests, avec fakeEngine, messages `pathHopMsg` / `pathDoneMsg` injectés à la main).
- `internal\ui\netdiag\trace_form_validation_test.go` : les 2 QF1011 sont corrigés (`var _ = (&Model{}).traceValidation` et `traceMarks`). Il reste l'import `components`, utilisé ailleurs dans le fichier, donc pas d'import mort.
- `internal\app\activity_guard_test.go` : `"ui/netdiag/trace_form.go"` et `"ui/netdiag/trace_level.go"` ajoutés à `command.ViewNetdiag`.

**Rouge, pour la bonne raison**
- `go test -gcflags=-e ./internal/ui/netdiag -run TestTrace` échoue au build. Les seules erreurs sont les 3 symboles à créer, aucune autre : `undefined: StateTrace`, `pm.startFromForm undefined`, `undefined: reasonTraceBusy`.
- `go test ./internal/app -run Activity` : `TestActivityGuardMigratedSourcesAreDeclared` échoue avec `view "netdiag": source prefix "ui/netdiag/trace_level.go" matches no file`. Il passera dès que `trace_level.go` existe (`trace_form.go` existe déjà). Je l'ai laissé rouge.
- `gofmt -d` montre le fichier entier différent. C'est la fin de ligne : `header.go`, `model.go` et d'autres fichiers du worktree sont signalés pareil. Je ne l'ai pas corrigé.

**Ce que couvrent les tests**
- `StateTrace` est après tous les états existants.
- `startFromForm` : préremplit le champ, lance, retourne une Cmd dont l'exécution appelle bien le trace (une fois). Plateforme non supportée : rien ne démarre.
- `enter` sur Trace Path :
  - il ouvre StateTrace sur l'onglet Diagnostics ;
  - `pm.running()` et `m.Running()` sont vrais ;
  - le trace ne tourne pas dans `Update` (0 appel), il tourne dans la Cmd.
- Titre : `Network`, puis `Path`, puis l'hôte, dans cet ordre. Un hôte de 83 caractères à largeur 50 est tronqué avec une ellipse et le préfixe reste. Pas de trail Path sur le formulaire.
- Rendu :
  - `Render() == pm.table.View()` pendant la course, avec hops et à la fin ;
  - `GetFooterHeight() == 3` et 3 lignes réellement rendues, en cours, terminé et annulé ;
  - le footer affiche `Tracing <hôte>` ;
  - l'en-tête vaut `Context` + `pathModel.headerInfo()`.
- `esc` :
  - 1er `esc` : état annulé, `OutcomeCancelled`, gen changé, hops conservés, toujours StateTrace ;
  - 2e `esc` : StateInput avec Target, Port et DNS conservés, focus sur le bouton, champ cible flouté, `m.results` conservé (donc pas de `resetToForm`).
- Terminé et annulé réagissent pareil : `esc` revient au formulaire ; `enter`, `ctrl+r` et `ctrl+o` ne font rien (pas de relance, pas de sélecteur, pas de Cmd). Les mêmes trois touches sont aussi testées pendant la course.
- Trace déjà lancé depuis le Path : `enter` sur Trace Path donne un footer Warn `reasonTraceBusy`, état StateInput, gen inchangé, aucun appel au trace.
- Raccourcis :
  - pendant la course, `[esc]` seul avec « Cancel the trace » ;
  - ensuite `[tab esc ?]`, esc = « Back to the form », identiques entre terminé et annulé ;
  - ni `enter`, ni `ctrl+r`, ni `ctrl+o` n'y figurent.
- Navigation (`end`, `up`, `home`, `down`) : déplace la sélection de `pm.table`.
- Frappes : lettres, `backspace` et paste n'atteignent ni `pm.input` ni `targetInput`, et `InEditMode()` reste faux. Test dédié `...AFailedRunDoesNotLeakTheKeyboardToTheHiddenField` pour le cas `handleDoneError`.
- `tab` puis `shift+tab` retrouve le sous-niveau ; les hops arrivent même depuis un autre onglet ; on peut relancer un trace après être revenu au formulaire.
- Table qui remplit le viewport : `RenderedWidth == w-2` pour les largeurs 120 et 60, et la table fait exactement 2 lignes de plus avec un footer de 3 qu'avec 5 (resize par `WindowSizeMsg`). Un test compare aussi la taille à celle de l'onglet Path.

**Hypothèses que le réviseur doit trancher (non précisées dans le contrat)**
1. Le séparateur du titre n'est pas vérifié (`›` ou `IconChevronRight`). Je teste seulement l'ordre `Network`, `Path`, hôte.
2. « Tronqué à la largeur » est testé comme `StringWidth(title) <= m.width` avec une ellipse `…` ou `...`.
3. Fin du trace sur erreur (`pathDoneMsg.err`) : je n'impose pas d'état particulier, seulement que le champ caché ne reçoit rien, que `InEditMode()` et `Running()` sont faux, et qu'un `esc` ramène à StateInput.
4. Le footer en StateTrace doit être celui de `pathModel` : message `pathModel.footer` + `statusLine()`, donc `activeFooter` doit le gérer.
5. Le Warn `reasonTraceBusy` va sur `m.footer` (le footer Diagnostics), comme `traceFromForm` le fait déjà pour `reasonPathUnsupported`.
